name: ilojista
description: Read a phone and electronics store's device catalog and funnel stages on iLojista.

interface.longDescription: iLojista connects your agent to the device catalog and sales funnel of a phone and electronics store in Brazil. Read the store's devices and accessories with their condition, storage in GB, color, battery health, trade-in value and sale status, and read the ordered stages of the store's funnel without exposing customer contacts or conversations. All tools are read-only.
capabilities: List devices and products in the store catalog
Read device storage, color, condition, battery health and trade-in value
List the ordered stages of the store sales funnel
defaultPrompt: Which iPhones are available in my iLojista store catalog right now?
Show the used devices in my iLojista catalog with their battery health.
What are the stages of my sales funnel on iLojista?
